title: featurePlanAction
responsibility: Bind local feature-plan selection and approval to the selected project and reviewed source, then admit only approved tasks.

inputs.name: featurePlanAction.context
inputs.description: Trusted selected project session; the caller holds the project repository lease.

inputs.name: featurePlanAction.input
inputs.description: Explicit project ID, feature and expected plan digest; selection names a page and option, while approval names a reviewer.

inputs.name: featurePlanAction.writable
inputs.description: Trusted caller check for a live client and a writable selected project revision.

outputs.name: featurePlanAction
outputs.description: Checks project identity, the latest plan digest and its source against the writable revision, then rechecks context. Selection commits a new unapproved plan revision. Approval uses the real readiness verifier, rechecks context, and submits the exact approved tasks without starting a worker. Repository and revision checks are repeated but do not lock external Git operations.

errors.name: Invalid or stale context
errors.description: Rejects missing or foreign project, stale digest, mismatched source, changed writable revision, ended client, or underlying service failures.

errors.name: Approval or submission failure
errors.description: Readiness and queue errors propagate. Approval can already be committed if context changes or submission fails afterward; the approved plan can be retried with the CLI task plan start command.
